note: A plainly-worded request with an explicit deadline. This is the easy case - if this one ever fails, something is badly wrong.
subject: 77 Birchwood Drive - revised commitment
body: Good morning. Please send the revised title commitment by Friday. Closing is set for 77 Birchwood Drive on Monday at 2:00 PM at the Cherry Hill office. File #KT-2026-0188.
